cards.title: Borrowed Authority
cards.instruction: Project confident authority while quietly working to keep everyone cooperative. Your confidence depends on their cooperation.

cards.title: Keep the Peace
cards.instruction: Hide a truth because you believe the relationship cannot survive one more conflict.

beats.speaker: A
beats.text: I'd like to keep this voluntary. Leave that letter under my plate. We only just managed breakfast together again. Please.

beats.speaker: B
beats.text: Has your brother cancelled paying us back?

beats.speaker: A
beats.text: I'm still in charge; we can make an adjustment. I've covered this month's rent. We don't need another suitcase in the hall.

beats.speaker: A
beats.text: Please finish breakfast with me first. Yesterday you finally unpacked; I can't risk you packing again.

mechanism: A directs a fragile reunion breakfast and accommodates meal preferences to keep B from opening a letter A fears will restart the conflict.
confusable: Unlike hiding for personal convenience, A explicitly fears another departure; borrowed authority trades breakfast service for cooperation with delaying the truth.
comparison: A concealed family-loan letter after unpacking differs from missing savings and a threatened bank call.
seedUse: Use D87-a letter/plate/rent/suitcase/breakfast and S02-a managing order while quietly yielding practical choices.
